goal: find a non-trivial hypothesis from this dataset which is significant and provable from the data

evidence.nontrivial_economic_hypothesis: Same rating improvement has a larger asking-price association at 100 than 10 reviews: an information-precision interaction, distinct from a generic quality premium.
evidence.explicit_statistical_test: Direct difference of rating coefficients; positive slope at 100 reviews plus positive slope difference; joint max-p test.
evidence.measured_dataset: September London raw data; 46,553 eligible listings; original host-disjoint samples independently verified.
evidence.significance: September training, validation and holdout joint tests pass correction for 21 counted substantive hypotheses.
evidence.replication: June same-source London snapshot and 3,143 listings from 2,440 hosts absent from ALL September raw rows; both corrected tests pass.
evidence.robustness: All planned checks pass joint ordinary 95% thresholds. September host-FE holdout fails stricter correction (p=.317), explicitly reported; every June planned check passes correction.
evidence.shape_diagnostics: All eight post-result curved-main-effect/high-rating checks pass correction; separately labelled post-result.
evidence.causal_scope: Empirical conditional hypothesis established with uncertainty. Information mechanism, causal effects and universal validity are not proved and are explicitly disclaimed.
evidence.failed_searches: Both preceding group-travel hypotheses retained and linked, no unsupported candidate reclassified.
evidence.verification: Source/code/plan hashes, raw cohort reconstruction, separate-host exclusion, direct OLS and independent contrast arithmetic passed; report local links valid; chart visually reviewed.
